findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.citation_text:
2-102.11 (A), (B) & (C)(1), (4)-(16) Priority violations for raw food storage and sanitization were observed. Facility had fountain sodas, slushes, and coffee service available without adequate facilities for ware washing. Active managerial controls and steps owner needs to take in order to resume beverage service of this nature were discussed. Owner voluntarily emptied slushee machine hoppers and shut off the soda machine, placing an out of order sign on it. Spot check will be conducted to check on status of of city permit needed to install the 3 part sink and plan review submission.
Based on the risks inherent to the food operation, during inspections and upon request the PIC shall demonstrate to the regulatory authority knowledge of foodborne disease prevention, application of the hazard analysis and critical control points, and the requirements of the Code.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.citation_text:
3-302.11 Packages of raw bacon and cartons of shell eggs were observed next to and above ready to eat foods, including deli meats, cheese, and milk, in the cooler. Owner rearranged products to allow for proper storage of raw bacon and shell eggs on the bottom shelf beneath all ready to eat foods. 
Food shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display by separating raw animal foods from ready to eat foods.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11 Food contact surfaces of fountain soda machine, slushee machine, and coffee pot are unable to be properly cleaned due to lack of adequate facilities (#48). Owner noted items are cleaned using the small handsink in back, which is a handwashing sink. Owner voluntarily ceased beverage service until adequate facilities can be installed to allow for proper cleaning of food contact surfaces.
Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) shall be cleaned at least up to every 24hrs or more frequently any time when contamination may have occurred.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-702.11 Food contact surfaces of fountain soda machine, slushee machine, and coffee pot are unable to be properly sanitized due to lack of adequate facilities (#48). Owner voluntarily ceased beverage service until adequate facilities can be installed to allow for proper sanitization of food contact surfaces.
Utensils and food contact surfaces shall be sanitized before use after cleaning.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-301.12 Facility is not adequately equipped with a 3 compartment sink to allow for manual wash, rinse, and sanitize of food contact surfaces for beverage service equipment. A 3 part sink with compartments large enough for immersion of equipment and utensils must be provided if owner wishes to resume beverage service. Owner intends to have a licensed plumber pull a permit with City of Springfield to have a 3 part sink installed. 
A sink with at least 3 compartments shall be provided for manually washing, rinsing, and sanitizing equipment and utensils. Sink compartments shall be large enough to accommodate immersion of here largest equipment and utensils.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text:
4-602.13 Counter under beverage service equipment was soiled with splash and general buildup. Clean the counter under the beverage machines and microwave used by staff daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.
Nonfood contact surfaces shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to eliminate buildup of grease, food splash and general debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 1) Cabinets were observed in disrepair at the drink counter, specifically in the cabinet under cup storage where sump pump is located for soda machine (far left cabinet) and cabinets with slushee syrups and Dr. Pepper syrup. Provide proper repairs to allow for easy maintenance and cleaning.
2) Portion of base coving was missing on the left side of the water heater in the restroom. Clean the floor and replace the base coving in this area.
Physical facilities shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 6-501.16: Observed a wet mop stored inside the top part of the mop bucket. Ensure the mop is stored properly after use. Inspector moved the mop to a position that allows it to air dry. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.113: Observed old mop water inside the mop bucket in the mop sink area. Ensure mop water is dumped out after use. 
Maintenance tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners, and similar items shall be: (A) Stored so they do not contaminate FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES; and (B) Stored in an orderly manner that facilitates cleaning the area used for storing the maintenance tools.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Raw Eggs stored on shelf directly above milk in reach in cooler

750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Cases of bottled water stored on the floor at the front of store

750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Fans in walk in cooler soiled with debris

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Single service coffee lids stored on floor in back storage room

750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
REPEAT>Leaky faucet on 3 compartment sink

750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.
